artists_artist_id: Unique Discogs identifier for the artist.
artists_artist_name: The artist's primary/credited name as listed on Discogs.
artists_artist_realname: The artist's real or legal name, when documented.
artists_artist_profile: Free-text biography or profile description of the artist.
artists_artist_data_quality: Discogs community data-quality flag for this entry (e.g. Correct, Needs Vote, Needs Major Changes).
artist_urls_url: External reference URLs for the artist (website, Wikipedia, social media). A JSON array when multiple exist.
artist_namevariations_name: Alternate spellings or variations of the artist's name seen across releases.
artist_aliases_name: Names of other Discogs artist entries considered aliases of this artist.
artist_aliases_name_id: Discogs artist IDs corresponding to each alias in artist_aliases_name.
artist_groups_name: Names of groups/bands this artist is credited as a member of.
artist_groups_name_id: Discogs artist IDs corresponding to each group in artist_groups_name.
artist_members_name: Names of individual members belonging to this artist entry, when the artist is a group/band.
artist_members_name_id: Discogs artist IDs corresponding to each member in artist_members_name.
